name: api-chat
displayName: API Chat (Claude CLI on API key)
description: Runs the Claude CLI in an editor panel, billed to your own Anthropic API key, with every permission request answered in the panel.

apiChat.claudePath.markdownDescription: Full path to the `claude` executable. Checked first; when empty, the Claude Code extension's bundled CLI, then `~/.local/bin`, then `claude` on PATH are used.

apiChat.backgroundWaitCeilingMs.markdownDescription: How long (ms) a print-mode run waits for background tasks (subagents, long commands) before exiting. `0` = no ceiling: wait however long they take. Sets `CLAUDE_CODE_PRINT_BG_WAIT_CEILING_MS` for the CLI.
